about: One graph of Storm Charles, Lisbon: Wednesday 11 November 2026: actors, decisions, warnings, signals, sources, places, datasets and agents, built from the incident's JSON files by tools/graph-build.mjs (never by hand). Every node and edge carries label (fact, evidence, hypothesis), source (URL), read (UTC) and origin (the file and place it came from). The ontology: data/graph/ontology.json. Not a warning service: follow IPMA and ANEPC.
origin_note: origin is file#pointer, relative to origin_base; a leading / means relative to the repository root. An edge's id is rel:from>to.
more: data/graph/storm-elsewhere.json: the warnings in force in the other districts (same shape; its edges point to nodes here)
